## Methods

### Synchronize

Write out all pending log messages out to disk, and reply only after that's complete.

```go
func (c *Client) Synchronize(ctx context.Context, in SynchronizeIn) error
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `offline` | `?bool` | Controls whether to offline the journal files as part of the synchronization operation. |

### Rotate

Rotate journal files, i.e. close existing files, start new ones.

```go
func (c *Client) Rotate(ctx context.Context) error
```

### FlushToVar

Flush runtime logs to persistent logs, i.e. flush log data from /run/ into /var/, and continue writing future log data to the latter location.

```go
func (c *Client) FlushToVar(ctx context.Context) error
```

### RelinquishVar

Relinquish use of /var/ again, return to do runtime logging into /run/ only.

```go
func (c *Client) RelinquishVar(ctx context.Context) error
```
